expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Writes a standard log message to the default AngelScript category. Writes an informational log message to the default category. Writes a display-level log message to the default category. Writes an error log message to the default category. Writes a warning log message to the default category. Writes a standard message only when Condition is true. Writes an informational message only when Condition is true. Writes a display-level message only when Condition is true. Writes an error message only when Condition is true. Writes a warning message only when Condition is true.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: void Log(const FString& Text); | void LogInfo(const FString& Text); | void LogDisplay(const FString& Text); | void Error(const FString& Text); | void Warning(const FString& Text); | void LogIf(bool Condition, const FString& Text); | void LogInfoIf(bool Condition, const FString& Text); | void LogDisplayIf(bool Condition, const FString& Text); | void ErrorIf(bool Condition, const FString& Text); | void WarningIf(bool Condition, const FString& Text);
